exposure: Women with GDM who did not initiate breastfeeding
Women with GDM who fully breastfed at five months
Women with GDM who fully breastfed at five weeks
Gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) managed by diet
cohort: 131 singleton offspring of Danish women with GDM managed by diet
finding: Despite lower breastfeeding rates than normally reported in Denmark, offspring of mothers with GDM who breastfed had lower BMI at the age of five months.
mod_finding: Lowest breastfeeding rates were seen following prelabour Caesarean delivery.
